issue.title: Project artifact links from agents to the beads they wait on
issue.description: An agent launched with `%wait(bead=<id>)` gets a durable, visible artifact link to that bead, just as `%id(..., bead=<id>)` already yields `agent:<name> implements bead:<id>`.

issue.title: Awaits relation in the sase-core registry
issue.description: core-relation: in the linked sase-core repo, add the projection-only `awaits` / `awaited-by` builtin relation to the artifact-link registry, with Rust tests.

issue.title: Publish bead waits and project awaits links
issue.description: wait-projection: publish `wait_for_beads` as portable agent metadata, add an `agent-wait-bead` projection rule emitting `agent:<name> awaits bead:<id>`, bump the sase-core pin, and update docs, TUI sigils, snapshots, and tests.

payload.entry: VERIFIED: sase-17o.1 — sase-core eef7ca4 (on origin/master, no later drift) adds projection-only awaits/awaited-by builtin with Rust tests. sase-17o.2 — 8d97ef766 pins eef7ca4, publishes normalized wait_for_beads (live + dismissed waiting_for_beads fallback) via V2_METADATA_FIELDS/portable_metadata, adds agent-wait-bead projection rule wired into project_link_rows, Python _PROJECTION_RELATIONS + stale-binding lookup/label fallbacks, link-rail 'wait' sigil, docs (artifact_links.md, xprompt.md), regenerated relation registry/memory, and tests. LAND WORK: the plan asked to factor the shared scan/cache loop instead of copying it; the phase copied _agent_bead.py nearly verbatim, so land extracted src/sase/artifact_links/projection/_agent_meta_scan.py (project_agent_meta_rows) and slimmed both rules to per-metadata row builders (rule ids/cache keys unchanged); 76 artifact_links/wait/fallback tests pass. INTEGRATION: post-start commits 075225d53, 71fff39d1, 7d2272588 are ACE deck work with no relation/link/metadata overlap; nothing to integrate. VERIFICATION: just check passes fmt/ruff/mypy/flags/pyscripts/waits/changelog/terminology, fails at pre-existing symvision (private-import backlog, none in epic files); toobig and sase validate pass; test-scoped escalated to full: 52 failures identical with/without land diff, all agent_family AgentMetaWire wire errors from in-flight sase-17m (DISCOVERED ISSUE noted on sase-17m). Live E2E not possible yet: no published meta.json carries wait_for_beads (historical waits not backfilled, per plan). FOLLOW-UPS (sase-17o.2): #1 agent-to-agent waits -> new task sase-17s; #2 drop stale-binding fallbacks after floor raise -> new task sase-17t (fallbacks needed until a sase-core release contains eef7ca4); #3 orphaned prompt-archive objects in agents sidecar -> reproduced, new bug sase-17u (related sase-fi); #4 symvision red on clean HEAD -> duplicate, +1 on sase-17l, sase-17j, sase-17c.
